info.submission:
Fixed two errors in the notebook:

1. **Cell 2**: Changed the data source from a local Git LFS pointer file to a publicly available Titanic dataset URL (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv). This fixed the KeyError: 'Embarked' that occurred in cell 3, as the local file was not actual CSV data but Git LFS pointer files.

2. **Cell 7**: Fixed AttributeError where the code tried to access `feature_importances_` on an SVC model object. SVC models don't have this attribute (only tree-based models do). Changed to use a RandomForestClassifier model instead and also corrected the index parameter to use the transformed features columns rather than the original data columns.

All cells now execute successfully without crashes.
